verification.confirmation_notes: 2026–28 Oregon Furbearer Trapping and Hunting Regulations (final booklet) verified 2026-09-18; ODFW permanent rule filing effective 7/1/2026 adopts the same framework. All season dates, the bobcat Western/Eastern bag-limit split, marten east-of-I-5 restriction, Sierra Nevada red fox protection area, beaver closures, year-round open species, and year-round closed species read directly from the booklet.
known_gaps: Scientific names are standard taxonomy, NOT stated in ODFW furbearer regulations — all flagged scientific_name_verified=false; weasel and spotted skunk are null because the regulations do not distinguish species.

Bobcat Western/Eastern Oregon zones, the marten I-5 boundary, the Sierra Nevada red fox protection area, and beaver county/watershed closures are modeled descriptively — the app cannot resolve exact boundaries.
Eastern Oregon is partly in the Mountain Time zone; all entries use America/Los_Angeles and the app should warn users in eastern Oregon accordingly.
No CITES/tagging specifics beyond what the booklet states are modeled.
